name: EXM_VALIDATION_RESULTS
description: This table contains validation results of spend authorization creation processes.

columns.name: VALIDATION_ID
columns.description: Validation result identifier of spend authorization.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to Expenses table that contains data that is the source of the validation. A possible value is EXPENSE_ID.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Expense table that contains data that is the source of error, such as EXM_EXPENSE_REPORTS or EXM_EXPENSES.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Name of FND, Foundation, message type.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME1
columns.description: First text token name of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME2
columns.description: Second text token name of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME3
columns.description: Third text token name of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME4
columns.description: Fourth text token name of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_NAME5
columns.description: Fifth text token name of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE1
columns.description: First token value of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE2
columns.description: Second token value of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE3
columns.description: Third token value of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE4
columns.description: Fourth token value of the message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TOKEN_VALUE5
columns.description: Fifth token value of the message.

columns.name: SEVERITY_NAME
columns.description: Severity of validation result. Possible values are Warning and Error.

columns.name: BC4J_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Attribute of object that generated error.

columns.name: BC4J_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of object attribute error.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of exception for the validation.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
